structured.approach: I followed the data-engineering-steps skill for DE-04. I fetched the four contracted inputs (feat.tasks, feat.design, org.data_model, task.repo_access) with context_get to get receipts. I also read the approved DE-02 and DE-03 outputs (task.secrets_scope, task.db_changes) as background. Then I read the existing ap_pipeline source, tests and schedule from the step's tool view (tool:repo) to see how the vendor CSV feed is ingested today. The question was whether feed v3, which adds the optional paid_date column, needs any ingestion code. parse_feed uses csv.DictReader, which is header-driven, so the new column arrives as a key with no code change and feed v2 keeps loading. pipeline.run, dq.quality_report and schedule.json also stay unchanged. So the ingestion-layer change list is: no source or pipeline code to create or update, plus one source-contract change (v2 to v3). For later steps I listed, without deciding them, the two components where the feature's code lands (transform.to_model with _parse_paid_date, and the new delays.py), taken from the TSK-01 and TSK-02 budgets. Secrets for all environments come from the approved DE-02 output: none are required. A verifier subagent checked the draft against the sources. I then fixed what it found: an unsupported 'empty when unpaid' phrase, unsourced statements about DE-07's role, present-tense wording for code that TSK-01 has not yet written, and two inferences that I now mark as agent judgement. Shell commands are not allowed in this step, so I used no Bash.

claims.text: Ingestion today is ingest.parse_feed, which returns one dict per CSV row via csv.DictReader keyed by the header; pipeline.run calls to_model(parse_feed(csv_text)) and returns the records with quality_report.

No ingestion source or pipeline code needs to be created or changed: ingest.py, dq.py, pipeline.py and schedule.json are on TSK-01's 'Must not change' list, and HC-3 (parse_feed, quality_report, run) is unchanged, with 'paid_date' flowing into reject_reasons by itself.
The feed row from csv.DictReader may lack the paid_date key (feed v2) or carry None (short row), and feed v2 without the paid_date column must still load.
The registered data model already includes paid_date (date or None), added in feed v3, so ingestion adds no further field.
The schedule stays daily at 02:00 Asia/Kolkata.

The feature's code changes sit outside ingestion: TSK-01 changes transform.py (with __init__.py for the version step only, and tests/test_pipeline.py), and TSK-02 adds the new delays.py and tests/test_delays.py.
No secrets are required or granted for the lane in local/CI, dev or main, so there is no gap; if releasing feed v3 needs a credential, DE-02 runs again.
ap_pipeline uses no Databricks workspace or database; work is on branch feature/story at 3fcbe1b with write access.
Feed v3 in production gates the release of TSK-01, not its coding; coding builds on synthetic v3 rows.

open_questions: CQ-I1 (non-blocking): Please confirm that the feed v3 header names the new column exactly 'paid_date'. parse_feed keys each row by the exact header text, and no input gives the v3 header specification. Interim answer: assume 'paid_date', as org.data_model and feat.design state.

CQ-I2 (non-blocking, carried from feat.design DQ-1): Which production component fetches the feed and calls pipeline.run? Interim answer: no ingestion code is affected; in this feature only the end-to-end harness wires the stages.
structured.summary: The ingestion layer needs no new or changed sources or pipelines. ingest.parse_feed is header-driven (csv.DictReader), so feed v3's optional paid_date column arrives with no code change and feed v2 keeps loading. pipeline.run, dq.quality_report and schedule.json (daily, 02:00, Asia/Kolkata) also stay unchanged. The only ingestion-side change is the v2 to v3 source contract, which the data model already holds. For later steps the output lists, from the task budgets, where the feature's code lands: TSK-01 in transform.py and TSK-02 in a new delays.py. Secrets in all environments: none required, none granted, no gap. The output has two non-blocking open questions: the exact v3 column name, and the production caller (carried as DQ-1).
